title: THE FUTURE OF DESIGN Stitch a platform by Google #ai #freeonlinetools
description:
Welcome to vibe design This is Stitch a platform by Google Labs that transforms a simple text prompt into a complex multiscreen interface in realtime As someone who has designed and built dozens of apps used by over 50M people throughout the years I cant explain to you how tedious the process used to be and how exciting of an era weve entered Does this kill designers Absolutely not Topclass human excellency and touch remain king But the bottlenecks are collapsing There has never been a more exciting time to build Whats new in Stitch AInative canvas An intelligent workspace that reasons across images code and text simultaneously capable of managing multiple ideas in parallel Smarter Design agent A contextaware agent that can critique designs generated PRDs or interview you to build pages from scratch Instant prototyping Preview your screens across devices stitch them together in seconds to experience the entirety of a user journey within your siteapp Design systems designmd Portable design rules via agentfriendly markdown files You can extract import or export your brand DNA anywhere Voice interactions Voiceactivated design experience literally feels like youre sitting next to a savvy designer with super human speed and youre instructing them exactly what you want This isnt sponsored but I did have early access to Stitch thanks to my friends at Google If you like this video follow me to stay two steps ahead on the incredibly disruption happening in tech and how to leverage it in content and business google stitch design ai
Roberto Nickson
